metadata.description: builder-kit and the four Clarity Club skills: build from a written plan, show before you change, break what you build, doubt every security finding, and write like a person.

plugins.name: builder-kit
plugins.description: builder-kit: build a product from a written plan in one hands-off run. It decides what the plan left open, builds, checks and reports, and leaves the project set up to last: tests kept in the repo, shared components, security checked, a record of every decision. Nothing stops a build.

plugins.name: sound-human
plugins.description: Removes the signs of AI writing from anything a person will read, in Australian English.

plugins.name: show-then-build
plugins.description: Shows a change before building it: a preview page to open, then a yes, then the build, checked against the preview.

plugins.name: build-then-break
plugins.description: Builds code with restraint, then tries to break it before calling it done. Replaces karpathy-guidelines and adversarial-review.

plugins.name: find-then-doubt
plugins.description: Security review for code you own: finds likely holes, then three reviewers try to knock each one down before it reaches the report.
